name: Healthcare Practice Management: Inbound document filing
description: Every 30 minutes during the day, reads new emails with attachments in the practice's Outlook inbox. The AI reads each PDF or image (scans and photos too) to tell a referral, test result, imaging report or other clinical letter from a non-clinical document, and who it's about. When exactly one Cliniko patient has the same name and date of birth, it files the document on that patient, adds a referral's doctor as a contact if new and opens a referral case, and tells the practitioner (results and imaging also get a review item in WorkQ). Otherwise it raises a WorkQ item with the Document filing form so a person picks the patient. Non-clinical attachments are skipped.
